review_locator: PMCID:PMC3255974, Structural specializations of alpha4beta7, an integrin that mediates rolling adhesion; PMCID:PMC4890615, Integrin-based Therapeutics: Biological Basis, Clinical Use and New Drugs
primary_title: Alpha 4 beta 7 integrin mediates lymphocyte binding to the mucosal vascular addressin MAdCAM-1
decision_basis: The integrin reviews identify MAdCAM-1 as the preferential mucosal vascular addressin ligand for alpha4beta7 and cite the primary study showing alpha4beta7-dependent binding to purified MAdCAM-1 and MAdCAM-1 transfectants.
limitations_preserved: Preserve the alpha4beta7 heterodimer, mucosal endothelial addressin, integrin-activation/Mn2+ and lymphocyte-homing context; no SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC3255974, Structural specializations of alpha4beta7, an integrin that mediates rolling adhesion
primary_title: The alpha 4 beta 1 and alpha 4 beta 7 integrins bind to distinct sites on vascular cell adhesion molecule 1
decision_basis: The alpha4beta7 adhesion review cites the primary binding study showing that VCAM-1 interacts with alpha4beta7 as well as alpha4beta1, with receptor activation state affecting the interaction.
limitations_preserved: Preserve alpha4beta7 activation-state dependence and the nonexclusive VCAM-1 interaction relative to alpha4beta1; no SCI inference.
